items.title: McCormick (NYSE:MKC) Posts Better-Than-Expected Sales In Q3 2026
items.summary: Food flavoring company McCormick (NYSE:MKC) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q3 2026, with sales up 17.4% year on year to $2.02 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.86 per share was 13.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: McCormick stock rises 5% on beating estimates as acquisition boosts sales
items.summary: Investment.com -- On Thursday, McCormick & Company (NYSE:MKC) reported third-quarter results that exceeded analyst expectations while reaffirming its full-year outlook. Shares of the company rose 4.79% in pre-market tradig following the announcement.
